seaward  shop-1

7 ports can be reached from outside. ufw allows only 4 of them.
Docker publishes the other 3 with rules of its own, which never pass ufw's list.

EXPOSED  tcp 5432  postgres in container db (postgres:16)
  Reachable from the internet. ufw does not allow it.
  reached by  the internet (IPv4 only)
  why         A rule in chain DOCKER of table nat sends it on to 172.18.0.2:5432,
              container db. From there it is forwarded, not delivered to this
              machine, so the INPUT chain, where ufw keeps its list, never sees it.
  rewritten   nat DOCKER
              -A DOCKER ! -i br-4c2f9a71d0e3 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 5432 -j DNAT --to-destination
                172.18.0.2:5432
  decided by  filter DOCKER
              -A DOCKER -d 172.18.0.2/32 ! -i br-4c2f9a71d0e3 -o br-4c2f9a71d0e3 -p tcp -m tcp
                --dport 5432 -j ACCEPT

EXPOSED  tcp 6379  redis-server in container cache (redis:7)
  Reachable from the internet. ufw does not allow it.
  reached by  the internet (IPv4 only)
  why         A rule in chain DOCKER of table nat sends it on to 172.18.0.3:6379,
              container cache. From there it is forwarded, not delivered to this
              machine, so the INPUT chain, where ufw keeps its list, never sees it.
  rewritten   nat DOCKER
              -A DOCKER ! -i br-4c2f9a71d0e3 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 6379 -j DNAT --to-destination
                172.18.0.3:6379
  decided by  filter DOCKER
              -A DOCKER -d 172.18.0.3/32 ! -i br-4c2f9a71d0e3 -o br-4c2f9a71d0e3 -p tcp -m tcp
                --dport 6379 -j ACCEPT

EXPOSED  tcp 8081  php in container adminer (adminer:4)
  Reachable from the internet. ufw does not allow it.
  reached by  the internet (IPv4 only)
  why         A rule in chain DOCKER of table nat sends it on to 172.18.0.4:8080,
              container adminer. From there it is forwarded, not delivered to this
              machine, so the INPUT chain, where ufw keeps its list, never sees it.
  rewritten   nat DOCKER
              -A DOCKER ! -i br-4c2f9a71d0e3 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8081 -j DNAT --to-destination
                172.18.0.4:8080
  decided by  filter DOCKER
              -A DOCKER -d 172.18.0.4/32 ! -i br-4c2f9a71d0e3 -o br-4c2f9a71d0e3 -p tcp -m tcp
                --dport 8080 -j ACCEPT

DEAD  tcp 8443
  ufw allows it, and nothing is listening.
  why         The firewall lets it through, but nothing is
              listening on tcp port 8443 at 203.0.113.10.
  decided by  filter ufw-user-input
              -A ufw-user-input -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8443 -j ACCEPT

           PORT      SERVICE          REACHED BY            UFW SAYS
  open     tcp 22    sshd             the internet          allowed, with a rate limit
  open     tcp 80    nginx            the internet          allowed
  open     tcp 443   nginx            the internet          allowed
  open     tcp 9100  node_exporter    198.51.100.0/24 only  allowed only from 198.51.100.0/24
  blocked  tcp 111   rpcbind          nobody                not allowed
  blocked  udp 111   rpcbind          nobody                not allowed
  local    tcp 53    systemd-resolve  this machine only     not allowed
  local    udp 53    systemd-resolve  this machine only     not allowed
  local    tcp 8125  statsd           this machine only     not allowed

seen from   the internet
            the local network on eth0 (203.0.113.0/24, 2001:db8:1::/64)
ufw allows  22/tcp, 80/tcp, 443/tcp, 9100/tcp from 198.51.100.0/24, 8443/tcp

Read from this machine's own rules. Anything in front
of it (a cloud firewall, a router) is not seen.
To follow a packet rule by rule: seaward why 5432
